sentences.text: Agentic AI is reaching core compliance work: Deutsche Bank has put agents into production on KYC onboarding, a story carried by seven outlets.
LHV Bank has rolled out agentic AI on customer emails, a sign that agents are moving into everyday servicing beyond the largest banks.

Among other Tier 1 banks, Bank of America is turning to AI for treasury payments and already uses its virtual assistant for internal self-service, while HSBC announced AI to review trade finance documentation.
In pilots, agents are starting to move money: Danske Bank, Rogers Bank and Revolut completed agentic payments, and GoCardless used an agent to transfer real money from a UK bank account.
